definitions.gloss: written impressions; book report; review essay
definitions.explanation: A piece of writing in which one describes their personal impressions, thoughts, and feelings about something they read, watched, or experienced. A staple of Japanese school assignments.

examples.japanese: {感想文|かんそうぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧。
⟦{夏休|なつやす}み→夏休み：02925_natsuyasumi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{宿題|しゅくだい}→宿題：00812_shukudai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧{感想文|かんそうぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{書|か}かされた。
examples.english: I was made to write a book report as summer homework.

examples.japanese: ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{観|み}た→観る：22793_miru⟧⟦{後|あと}→後：09580_ato⟧、{感想文|かんそうぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{四百字|よんひゃくじ}{詰|づ}め⟦{原稿用紙|げんこうようし}→原稿用紙：15790_genkouyoushi⟧{三枚|さんまい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦まとめた→まとめる：02424_matomeru⟧。
examples.english: After watching the movie, I wrote up my impressions on three sheets of 400-character manuscript paper.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{感想|かんそう}→感想：00450_kansou⟧ (impressions, thoughts) + ⟦{文|ぶん}→文：03716_bun⟧ (writing, text). This is one of the most common school writing assignments in Japan, particularly the ⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧{感想文|かんそうぶん} (book report) assigned during summer break.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧{感想文|かんそうぶん} — book report (the most common type)
- {感想文|かんそうぶん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{書|か}く→書く：00477_kaku⟧ — to write a review/report
- ⟦{映画|えいが}→映画：02273_eiga⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{感想文|かんそうぶん} — movie review essay
- {感想文|かんそうぶん}⟦コンクール→コンクール：28795_konkuuru⟧ — book report contest

CULTURAL NOTE:
The ⟦{読書|どくしょ}→読書：03484_dokusho⟧{感想文|かんそうぶん} is a defining feature of Japanese school culture. Students from elementary through high school are assigned to read a book and write their personal impressions. Many students dread this assignment, and it has become a common topic in discussions about Japanese education.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{感想|かんそう}→感想：00450_kansou⟧ — impressions, thoughts (spoken or written)
- ⟦{書評|しょひょう}→書評：12888_shohyou⟧ — book review; more formal and analytical than {感想文|かんそうぶん}
- ⟦{作文|さくぶん}→作文：02884_sakubun⟧ — essay, composition; broader term for any written assignment
